_format.note: Conditions are stackable status effects. Each entry defines its tick behavior (when stacks emit effects), and how stacks decay. The five conditions are kept aligned with the writing: FEVERING (heat / unrest), MENDING (closure / care), DRAINED (depletion), BROKEN (instability), SEDATED (suppression). All conditions live in fighter.conditions as { id: stacks }.
_format.tickOn: ownTurnStart fires the tick at the start of the affected side's turn. cardPlay fires when the affected side plays any card.
_format.decay: endOfOwnTurn reduces stacks by 1 at end of affected side's turn. perCardPlay reduces 1 per card the affected side plays. none = persists.
_format.target: self means the tick affects the carrier; enemy means it affects the carrier's opponent. Most tick effects target self (carrier suffers / benefits).

FEVERING.name: Fevering
FEVERING.desc: At your turn start, {stacks} pages are added to your file.

MENDING.name: Mending
MENDING.desc: At your turn start, {stacks} pages are removed from your file. Decays each turn.

DRAINED.name: Drained
DRAINED.desc: At your turn start, lose {stacks} insight this turn. Decays each turn.

BROKEN.name: Broken
BROKEN.desc: Cards cost +1 insight to play. Decays as you play cards.

SEDATED.name: Sedated
SEDATED.desc: You draw {stacks} fewer cards next turn. Decays each turn.
